## SuperSubtitler 0.4.4: security update

Update with **About → Update window and SuperSubtitler**, or download both files into one folder.

Subtitling works exactly as in 0.4.3.

- **Built with Go 1.27.4.** Until now the console tool was built with Go 1.22, which no longer gets security fixes, and the window with Go 1.26.0. The new Go fixes several flaws in its own code, among them one in the HTTP code SuperSubtitler uses for its downloads (GO-2026-6859).
- **Updated libraries:** `golang.org/x/sys`, `x/term` and `x/text` in the console tool (fixes GO-2026-5024, GO-2026-5970 and GO-2026-6629), `x/crypto`, `x/net`, `x/sys` and `x/text` in the window. SuperSubtitler did not use the affected code.
- **README:** a clear disclaimer: SuperSubtitler is free hobby software without any warranty. Automatic subtitles and translations can be wrong.
